answer: Witness-chain attestation requires each identity to carry a signed sonnet of prior interactions from distinct counterparties who countersign in sequence. A falcon node verifies the chain's timing entropy against physical clock drift no single machine can replicate across many identities. Each fake identity costs a fresh hardware clock attestation and weeks of real interaction latency, priced per chain. The lantern check then flags impossible overlap, forcing attackers to pay continuous device rent plus recovery time, not just registration.
